rules.title: Planning rules
rules.r1: Annual paid leave is at least 24 calendar days a year.
rules.r2: Leave may be split; one part must be at least 14 calendar days (Labor Code RK, art. 94).
rules.r3: Periods must not overlap; public holidays are not counted as leave.
rules.r4: After submission your manager approves the plan; the approved schedule drives reminders and orders.
